title: gypsophila perfoliata var. ilerdensis
intro: Gypsophila perfoliata var. ilerdensis, commonly known as Ilerdense Baby's Breath, is a variety of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Ilerdense Baby's Breath include its antispasmodic, sedative, and antianxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other phytochemicals, although further research is needed to fully understand its properties and uses.
